name: Searchify full redesign — marketing (Signal/Dusk), app (Figma light + slate dark), onboarding (AI auto-discovery)
summary: Complete visual overhaul: cinematic animated marketing site, clean modern SaaS app from the user's Figma design system (light) with an authored Perplexity/Claude-style soft dark theme, and a full-screen AI auto-discovery onboarding stepper.

sections.title: Landing page
sections.description: Full landing page: cinematic live-audit hero, engine strip, kinetic dividers, four-chapter story, features bento, proof band, CTA and footer.

sections.title: Pricing page
sections.description: Pricing hero, animated BYOK zero-markup flow, four tier cards with Pro rim highlight, full comparison table, FAQ and closing CTA.

sections.title: Design language
sections.description: The Signal system documented: principles, Dusk tokens, typography, gradient usage rules, elevation, live motion demos and components.

sections.title: App Shell + Visibility Overview Dashboard
sections.description: Grouped-nav shell and the Visibility home: hero score ring, KPI strip, 12-run trend, competitors, share of answers, per-model breakdown.

sections.title: Prompts — List Pattern, Filters & Empty State
sections.description: List-page pattern extended from the Figma language: banner, search + topic/engine/branded filters, topic-grouped table, sparklines, pagination, and a rich empty state.

sections.title: Site Health — Page Detail
sections.description: Figma SiteHealthDetail rendered as product UI: crawled-URL header, Technical/AEO/Combined score rings, delivery metrics, severity issues with remediation, issue history.

sections.title: Step 1 — Brand entry
sections.description: Full-screen stepper opens with just brand name + website URL (aliases collapsed) and a gradient 'Discover with AI' CTA.

sections.title: Step 2 — AI auto-discovery
sections.description: Animated AI progress: scanning the site, finding competitors and owned domains, drafting prompts, with a live found-so-far feed.

sections.title: Step 3 — Review & confirm
sections.description: Pre-checked, editable AI results — competitors, owned domains, starter prompts — with selection summary, then create project.

sections.title: Sign-in screen
sections.description: Split-screen sign-in: Figma-token form card, solid royal CTA, gradient brand panel with product proof points.

sections.title: Create-account screen
sections.description: Register variant of the auth shell; brand panel previews the 3-step AI onboarding the user is about to enter.
